scope: Batches 45–46 additive mixed-document source-text/date/voice/rendering requirements only; documentation candidate, no implementation or export.

requirements.case: Blyth cover, Bashford report and damaged date layer
requirements.requirement: Keep 1690 as a composite: Blyth’s cover and Bashford’s silkworm experiments are distinct voices, while Darwin’s later numbered or pencil questions are a separate undated layer. Preserve the garbled duplicated P4 text and the XML July 4–December 31 bounds; do not render the cover date as the date of every experimental block.

exact_source_evidence.quote: Facts on the interbreeding of different races of Silkworms, by F. Bashford Esq

requirements.case: Absent Darwin annotations section and missing prompt
requirements.requirement: Retain 1759A’s answer to the missing October 5 Darwin note and the quoted pamphlet marginalia in footnote apparatus. The HTML has no separate CD-annotations section and the original annotation was not inspected; do not invent a full prompt or merge the pamphlet text into McAndrew’s voice.

exact_source_evidence.quote: your very kind note of yesterdays date
it has never been my lot to fall in with drift timber

requirements.case: Authorial book count versus apparatus reading log
requirements.requirement: Preserve the author’s statement that two Miller books were read separately from apparatus naming three dated reading-log items. The Witness article was only reported orally and its date was requested; do not treat the later bibliographic identification as proof of possession or complete reading.

exact_source_evidence.quote: They could not tell me at all the date of the Witness

requirements.requirement: Keep 1524’s request to address and post the enclosed 1525 as a same-author cover/enclosure relation. Preserve 1525 as available evidence of the July 23 book completion, while leaving delivery or forwarding unproved; it is not an incoming Galton prompt.

exact_source_evidence.quote: direct & post the enclosed letter to Mr Galton

requirements.case: Observed versus inferred map lines in referee report
requirements.requirement: Render 840 as a qualified referee report: mapped observations, inferred arches and uncertain lines remain distinct, with requested map keys and terminology corrections. Do not convert publication endorsement into certainty of all geological claims or import later printed changes.

exact_source_evidence.quote: it is not possible to discover which lines, & how far along each line, are the result of actual observation

requirements.case: Complete book reading versus requested missing details
requirements.requirement: Preserve that Darwin read the Souvenirs every word while still requesting the absent experimental details of Flourens’s third-generation hybrid claim and an unavailable horse pamphlet. Future journal sending remains prospective; do not use a complete reading statement to fill missing evidence.

exact_source_evidence.quote: every word of which I have read with much interest
whether they were sterile with the pure species, or only sterile one hybrid with another.

requirements.requirement: Keep 1425F as an incomplete catalogue synopsis plus collective memorial excerpt. Darwin is one listed signatory, which does not establish individual Charles authorship of the prose; do not convert the collective appeal or later annuity outcome into a Darwin-authored answer.

requirements.case: Stable hybrid observation and unknown later generation
requirements.requirement: Preserve Salter’s observed Geum stability as “precisely the same as the first crop,” separately from the uncertain Epilobium generation and hypothetical reciprocal Linaria cross. Seed capsules are promised, not received; editorial variability and general infinite-generation claims are not body evidence.

exact_source_evidence.quote: are precisely the same as the first crop
may be only the 2d. generation or that of any other subsequent number.

requirements.case: Personal receipt versus Athenaeum custody and unstated month
requirements.requirement: Keep Darwin’s personal receipt of Smith’s letter three days before July 4 distinct from the earlier Athenaeum postal arrival and the incoming letter’s unstated eighth month. Preserve the twelve-line gap, removed signature and postscript; do not reconstruct the missing material or settle June as fact.

exact_source_evidence.quote: I received, only three days ago, your letter of the 8th addressed to the Athenæum.

requirements.case: Broad questioned date and ambiguous recipient
requirements.requirement: Retain 13892’s incomplete body, questioned Sharpey attribution and broad 1853–72 date window. The unnamed proposed man and lost list cannot be identified as Hooker from the summary; preserve the pronoun and recipient uncertainty.

exact_source_evidence.quote: but I will do so, if he is not on list.

requirements.requirement: Keep 1579A’s finished collection separate from boxes not yet determined, planned carriage to the station, and the proposed reimbursement by postal order. “I will inform you when they are sent off” is future dispatch; do not render payment or shipment as completed.

exact_source_evidence.quote: I will inform you when they are sent off
The Boxes (I do not yet know whether 2 or 3 will be required)

requirements.case: Recovered Parker circular question, supplemental only
requirements.requirement: Preserve the recovered Parker interrogative as a separately identified supplemental question witness, with its exact DOM span and limited extent. It is not a separate DCP catalogue item and the original circular is unavailable; do not promote it to a normal transcript or change graph counts before supplemental admission.

coverage.targets_and_contexts: All accepted primary target/context coverage is represented by the parent readings; named boundary cases are explicit and the remaining custody/publication stages are retained in the consolidated final case.
coverage.supplemental_question: DCP-LETT-1480A Parker question recovered, pending supplemental admission; no normal transcript or graph count change.

notes: Exact source evidence is checked against literal body blocks and unique DOM nodes where asserted. The Parker recovered question is separately identified supplemental evidence with limited quoted extent. Quote/DOM validation does not establish substantive prose truth or complete reading; voice, date, apparatus, missing sections, later annotations and physical custody remain separate.
